caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high back and armrests. The chair is brown in color, with visible wood grain texture throughout its structure. The backrest features two horizontal panels; the top panel is elaborately carved with a floral and scroll pattern, while the lower panel also has carved decorative elements. The seat appears flat and solid, with a similarly carved apron below the seat’s front edge that mirrors the floral and scroll motifs of the backrest. Both armrests are supported by turned wooden posts and are slightly curved outward for comfort. The front legs are rectangular and straight, while the arm supports are also turned and decorated. The overall composition places the chair centered against a plain, light beige background, emphasizing the details of the woodwork. There is a small red signature or stamp in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Chair (Arm)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
